body:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Prod cluster prod-east-1 experiencing repeated autoscaler churn for inference-pool-3. Recent spike in KV cache entries and continuous-batching window growth. Pager: @emi_oncall  
emi_oncall: saw the alert. pulling logs + grafana now. any immediate customer reports? 
raj_k: product reported elevated generate latency ~5m ago, some 504s. not full outage but visible errors for heavy burst workloads. 
lena_s: metrics: kv_cache_entries jumped from ~20k to 250k in 3m, batch.size p95 went from 8->72. autoscaler executed 4 scale-ups + 3 scale-downs in 6m. 
emi_oncall: that matches - looks like continuous batching is accumulating large prefixes + cache blowup causing slower evictions and longer CPU on CPU side which delays readiness -> HPA thrash. plan: 1) temporarily disable continuous batching on pool to stop batch growth, 2) set HPA min pods=6, max=40 and increase stability window to 180s, 3) warmup KV cache on new nodes to avoid cold-pop thrash. applying step 1 now. 
chris_ops: +1 to disable continuous batching, we saw similar pattern in staging last month.  
emi_oncall: running: 
```bash
# disable continuous batching for inference-pool-3 config 
realtimectl set-config --pool inference-pool-3 --batching.continuous false 
# patch HPA stability window 
kubectl patch hpa inference-pool-3-hpa -n prod --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":180},"scaleUp":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":180}}},"spec":{"minReplicas":6,"maxReplicas":40}}'
``` 
infra-bot: config change applied to inference-pool-3: batching.continuous=false by emi_oncall at 1769059989 
emi_oncall: disabled continuous batching. watching metrics now (10s). 
lena_s: querying logs: autoscaler still triggered two times after change but with reduced magnitude. kv_cache_entries growth halted ~1m after change. 
raj_k: customer impact summary for SRE channel & oncall: ~3 customers of top-50 saw degraded P95 latency 1.2x and temporary 504s. estimated 5% of requests from heavy-burst customers impacted during peak 16:02-16:10 UTC. no data exfiltration or model correctness issues. 
emi_oncall: mitigation 2 (HPA patch) in flight, will also push a small warmup job to pre-populate KV on new nodes so we don't hit cold penalties if autoscaler scales. warmup plan: run 6 workers with curated prefix sets for top 20 models. 
chris_ops: warmup script (kubectl run) ready: 
```bash
kubectl run kv-warmup-001 -n prod --image=redwood/kv-warmup:stable --replicas=6 -- \
  --targets "model: redwood/mistral-7b|prefixes:/warmup/prefixes/top20.txt"
``` 
emi_oncall: launched warmup at 1769060302. starting a short-lived telemetry dashboard: `/d/ai/kv-cache` on grafana. 
infra-bot: HPA patch succeeded at 1769060345. minReplicas=6, maxReplicas=40, stabilizationWindowSeconds=180. 
lena_s: after warmup, measured cold-start miss ratio dropped from 22% -> 4% on new nodes. p95 latency trending down. 
emi_oncall: good. marking incident as mitigation in-progress. need to notify sales/support for impacted customers. @lena_s can you draft a quick note for CS with what happened + mitigations? 
lena_s: on it. DM to #customer-success with details & timeline. 
raj_k: heads-up: I'll be taking the overnight oncall at 1769061200 UTC. if anything regresses, escalate to me. emi_oncall, can you do a quick handoff summary? 
emi_oncall: handoff: continuous batching caused KV prefix accumulation -> kv_cache_entries surge -> autoscaler thrash. Actions taken: disabled continuous batching, patched HPA to increase stabilization window and set minReplicas=6, launched KV warmup jobs, monitoring for regressions, customer-impact: limited 5% request errors for bursty customers between 16:02-16:10 UTC. Next steps for oncall: observe for 2h, if kv_cache_entries starts climbing again: 1) revert to previous batching config only for non-prod, 2) apply limit `batch.max_concurrent_requests=100` as temporary throttle, 3) coordinate with runtime team for a fast followup to add per-prefix TTL eviction. 
raj_k: thanks. I'll own overnight. if I need escalation, ping @chris_ops and @lena_s. 
chris_ops: recommend a postmortem to capture: - root cause analysis for why continuous batching lacks safeguards - HPA tuning defaults - improve warmup automation. tagging eng-runtime + eng-sre. 
emi_oncall: agreed. will open incident ticket and include logs + grafana snapshots. incident-bot: create incident ticket? 
incident-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0457, severity: P2, linked to thread 1769059876. 
raj_k: acknowledged. taking over. emi_oncall: thanks for the fast mitigation. 
emi_oncall: handing off now, online for 10 more mins for questions. :thumbsup: 
infra-bot: monitoring alert cleared for autoscaler-thrash in prod-east-1 at 1769061498.
raj_k: noted. will update if anything else crops up.
